name: cap-table
description: A cap table calculator for SAFEs, notes and priced rounds, with dilution math to the share.

interface.longDescription:
Zovo Cap Table Calculator is a cap table calculator, SAFE calculator and startup dilution calculator for founders raising money, inside the chat. Give your current holders (founders, granted options, the unallocated option pool, prior rounds) and the next event, and it returns the pro-forma cap table before and after with each holder's fully diluted ownership and dilution.

It handles the instruments founders actually raise on:
- Post-money SAFEs in the YC standard form, with a valuation cap, a percentage off the round's share value, or both, and MFN SAFEs
- Pre-money SAFEs
- Convertible notes with simple interest from the issue date to the conversion date, a cap and a percentage-off term
- A priced round with a pre-money valuation, new money, several investors and a target option pool that is topped up in the pre-money (the option pool shuffle)

For each SAFE and note it shows the per-share value at the cap, the per-share value after the percentage-off term, the conversion value it gets (the lower of the two) and the shares issued. The round's per-share value depends on the conversions and the pool top-up, which depend on that value; this circular system is solved with fraction math (no floating point), then rounded to whole shares at the end, and the method is stated in the result.

A quick SAFE ownership check answers "how much of my company does this SAFE buy": investment divided by the post-money valuation cap, alone or combined with other SAFEs.

You get an Excel cap table (before and after, conversions, summary) and a PDF summary, and the interactive view shows before and after ownership bars by holder or by group.

Limitations: this is an illustrative model, not legal, tax or investment advice; the real SAFE, note and round documents govern. One priced round per call. Liquidation preferences, participation, anti-dilution adjustments, vesting and 409A valuations are not modeled. Note caps use the fully diluted shares before the round, excluding converting securities, and the pool target refers to the unallocated pool after the round; some documents define these differently.

positive.description: SAFE and Series A with option pool shuffle
positive.prompt: Founders own 9M shares, option pool 1M. $1M of SAFEs at a $10M post-money cap, then a $5M Series A at $20M pre with a 10% pool. Show the cap table
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_cap_table with the founders (9,000,000), the pool (1,000,000), the SAFE ($1,000,000 at a $10,000,000 post-money cap) and the round. The SAFE cap price is 0.9 and it converts into 1,111,111 shares. The pool is topped up by 444,445 shares to 10% after the round. Price per share 1.730769; 14,444,444 fully diluted shares after. Founders go from 90% to 62.31%; the SAFE owns 7.69% and the new investors 20%. Links to the Excel cap table and the PDF.

positive.prompt: How much of my company does a $500k SAFE at a $10M post-money cap buy?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_safe_ownership with investment 500000 and valuation_cap 10000000. Reports 5% ownership ($500,000 / $10,000,000) before any priced round, existing holders keep 95%, and with the default 10,000,000 existing shares a SAFE price of 0.95 and 526,315 shares. Notes that a priced round dilutes this further.

positive.prompt: Founders have 10,000,000 shares. A $100k post-money SAFE has a $5M cap. We raise a $5M Series A at $20M pre-money. What does the cap table look like?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_cap_table. The SAFE converts at the cap price 0.49 into 204,081 shares; the Series A price is 1.96 and the new investors buy 2,551,020 shares. After the round founders own 78.40%, the SAFE holder 1.60% and the Series A investors 20%. States that this is an illustrative model, not legal advice.

positive.prompt: Founders 8M shares, pool 2M. A $250k note at 6% interest issued 2025-03-01, $6M cap, 20% discount, converts in a $3M seed at $12M pre on 2026-03-01. Model it
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_cap_table with the note and the seed round. 365 days of 6% simple interest add $15,000, so $265,000 converts. Cap price 0.6 vs discount price 0.919393: the cap price applies and the note gets 441,666 shares. Seed price 1.149242; founders go from 80% to 61.29%.

positive.description: Option pool top-up in a seed round
positive.prompt: Founders 8M shares, pool 500k. We raise $2M at $8M pre and the investor wants a 15% post-money option pool. What is the price per share and founder dilution?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_cap_table with target_pool_percent 15. The pool is topped up by 1,346,154 shares in the pre-money, the price per share is 0.8125, the new investors own 20% and the pool 15% after the round, and founders go from 94.12% to 65%.

pl-PL.subtitle: Tabela kapitalizacji i SAFE
pl-PL.description: Zovo Cap Table Calculator to kalkulator tabeli kapitalizacji (cap table), kalkulator SAFE i kalkulator rozwodnienia udziałów w startupie, który działa w czacie. Podaj obecnych udziałowców (założycieli, przyznane opcje, nieprzydzieloną pulę opcji, wcześniejsze rundy) i kolejne zdarzenie: SAFE typu post-money (standard YC) z limitem wyceny, dyskontem lub MFN, SAFE typu pre-money, pożyczki zamienne z odsetkami prostymi albo rundę z wyceną pre-money, nowymi środkami i docelową pulą opcji uzupełnianą w wycenie pre-money. Dostajesz tabelę przed i po, cenę za akcję, cenę konwersji każdego instrumentu (niższą z ceny z limitu i ceny z dyskontem), liczbę wydanych akcji i rozwodnienie każdego udziałowca, a także plik Excel i podsumowanie PDF. Obliczenia są dokładne (ułamki), zaokrąglane do pełnych akcji na końcu. To model poglądowy, a nie porada prawna ani podatkowa; wiążące są rzeczywiste dokumenty.

de-DE.subtitle: Cap Table und SAFE-Rechner
de-DE.description: Zovo Cap Table Calculator ist ein Cap-Table-Rechner, SAFE-Rechner und Verwässerungsrechner für Startups direkt im Chat. Geben Sie die aktuellen Anteilseigner an (Gründer, gewährte Optionen, nicht zugeteilter Optionspool, frühere Runden) und das nächste Ereignis: Post-Money-SAFEs nach YC-Standard mit Bewertungsobergrenze, Abschlag oder MFN, Pre-Money-SAFEs, Wandeldarlehen mit einfachen Zinsen oder eine Finanzierungsrunde mit Pre-Money-Bewertung, neuem Kapital und einem Ziel-Optionspool, der in der Pre-Money-Bewertung aufgestockt wird. Sie erhalten die Cap Table vorher und nachher, den Preis je Aktie, den Wandlungspreis jedes Instruments (der niedrigere aus Cap-Preis und Abschlagspreis), die ausgegebenen Aktien und die Verwässerung jedes Anteilseigners, dazu eine Excel-Datei und eine PDF-Zusammenfassung. Die Rechnung ist exakt (Brüche) und wird erst am Ende auf ganze Aktien gerundet. Es ist ein Modell zur Veranschaulichung, keine Rechts- oder Steuerberatung; maßgeblich sind die echten Dokumente.

es-ES.subtitle: Cap table y calculadora SAFE
es-ES.description: Zovo Cap Table Calculator es una calculadora de cap table, calculadora de SAFE y calculadora de dilución para startups que funciona dentro del chat. Indica los accionistas actuales (fundadores, opciones concedidas, pool de opciones sin asignar, rondas anteriores) y el siguiente evento: SAFE post-money estándar de YC con tope de valoración, descuento o MFN, SAFE pre-money, notas convertibles con interés simple o una ronda con valoración pre-money, dinero nuevo y un pool de opciones objetivo que se amplía en la valoración pre-money. Obtienes la cap table antes y después, el precio por acción, el precio de conversión de cada instrumento (el menor entre el precio del tope y el precio con descuento), las acciones emitidas y la dilución de cada accionista, además de un Excel y un resumen en PDF. El cálculo es exacto (fracciones) y se redondea a acciones enteras al final. Es un modelo ilustrativo, no asesoramiento legal ni fiscal; mandan los documentos reales.

fr-FR.subtitle: Cap table et calculateur SAFE
fr-FR.description: Zovo Cap Table Calculator est un calculateur de table de capitalisation, un calculateur de SAFE et un calculateur de dilution pour startups, directement dans la conversation. Indiquez les détenteurs actuels (fondateurs, options attribuées, pool d'options non attribué, tours précédents) et l'événement suivant : SAFE post-money au standard YC avec plafond de valorisation, décote ou MFN, SAFE pre-money, obligations convertibles avec intérêts simples, ou un tour avec valorisation pre-money, argent frais et un pool d'options cible complété dans la valorisation pre-money. Vous obtenez la table avant et après, le prix par action, le prix de conversion de chaque instrument (le plus bas entre le prix plafond et le prix décoté), les actions émises et la dilution de chaque détenteur, ainsi qu'un fichier Excel et une synthèse PDF. Le calcul est exact (fractions) et arrondi aux actions entières à la fin. Il s'agit d'un modèle illustratif, pas d'un conseil juridique ou fiscal ; les documents réels font foi.

ja-JP.subtitle: 資本政策表とSAFE計算
ja-JP.description: Zovo Cap Table Calculator は、チャットの中で使える資本政策表（キャップテーブル）計算、SAFE 計算、スタートアップの希薄化計算ツールです。現在の株主（創業者、付与済みオプション、未割当のオプションプール、過去のラウンド）と次のイベントを入力します。YC 標準のポストマネー SAFE（評価額上限、割引、MFN）、プレマネー SAFE、単利の利息が付く転換社債、またはプレマネー評価額・新規資金・目標オプションプール（プレマネーで補充）を伴う株式ラウンドに対応します。前後の資本政策表、1 株あたり価格、各証券の転換価格（上限価格と割引価格の低い方）、発行株式数、各株主の希薄化を返し、Excel ファイルと PDF の要約も作成します。計算は分数による厳密計算で、最後に整数株に丸めます。これは説明用のモデルであり、法務・税務アドバイスではありません。実際の契約書が優先します。

pt-BR.subtitle: Cap table e calculadora SAFE
pt-BR.description: Zovo Cap Table Calculator é uma calculadora de cap table, calculadora de SAFE e calculadora de diluição para startups que funciona dentro do chat. Informe os acionistas atuais (fundadores, opções concedidas, pool de opções não alocado, rodadas anteriores) e o próximo evento: SAFEs post-money no padrão YC com teto de valuation, desconto ou MFN, SAFEs pre-money, notas conversíveis com juros simples ou uma rodada com valuation pre-money, dinheiro novo e um pool de opções alvo complementado no pre-money. Você recebe a cap table antes e depois, o preço por ação, o preço de conversão de cada instrumento (o menor entre o preço do teto e o preço com desconto), as ações emitidas e a diluição de cada acionista, além de um Excel e um resumo em PDF. O cálculo é exato (frações) e arredondado para ações inteiras no final. É um modelo ilustrativo, não aconselhamento jurídico ou fiscal; valem os documentos reais.
